# DevTools Hub - Free Online Developer Tools

Welcome to DevTools Hub! This site provides free, browser-based developer tools for common coding tasks. No signup required.

## Available Tools

### Formatters
- **JSON Formatter** - Format, validate, minify, and beautify JSON with syntax highlighting. Convert JSON to YAML. Detect syntax errors with line numbers.
- **HTML Formatter** - Format, prettify, and beautify HTML code with proper indentation. Validate HTML syntax and fix common errors.
- **SQL Formatter** - Format, beautify, and prettify SQL queries. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite.

### Calculators & Converters
- **Calculator** - Free online calculator with Basic, Scientific, Unit Converter, Loan Calculator, and BMI Calculator. Solves everyday math problems including unit conversions, loan payments, and health metrics.
- **Currency Converter** - Convert between 166+ world currencies with live exchange rates. Free online currency calculator with instant results for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY and more.
- **Timestamp Converter** - Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates. Shows current timestamp updating in real-time.
- **Time Zone Converter** - Convert time between cities worldwide. See current time in multiple locations instantly. Perfect for international meetings and travel planning.
- **Color Picker** - Pick colors and convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL formats with live preview and copy buttons.
- **Word Counter** - Count words, characters, sentences with readability scores and keyword density analysis. Perfect for SEO writers and students.

### Generators
- **Password Generator** - Generate strong, secure passwords with real-time strength analysis and NIST 800-63B compliance checking. Uses Web Crypto API for cryptographically secure randomness.
- **QR Code Generator** - Create QR codes for URLs, text, WiFi networks, email, SMS, vCards, and phone numbers. Download as PNG.
- **Hash Generator** - Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 checksums instantly in your browser.
- **UUID Generator** - Generate UUID v1, v4, and v7 identifiers. Supports single and bulk generation up to 100 UUIDs.
- **Cron Generator** - Create and validate cron expressions. See next execution times and test schedules interactively.

### Encoders & Decoders
- **Base64 Encoder** - Encode and decode Base64 strings. Supports standard and URL-safe Base64 variants.
- **URL Encoder** - Encode and decode URLs for safe transmission. Handles special characters, spaces, and Unicode.

### Network Tools
- **Speed Test** - Free internet speed test. Check your download speed, upload speed, and latency instantly in your browser. No software install needed.
- **IP Address Lookup** - Find your public IP address, geolocation, ISP information instantly. Verify VPN and check network settings.

### Code Testing
- **Regex Tester** - Test regular expressions with real-time matching. Supports g, i, m, s flags. See match count and captured groups.
- **JWT Decoder** - Decode and verify JSON Web Tokens. Inspect claims, validate format, and check expiration times.

## Key Features

- **Privacy First**: All processing happens in your browser. Your code never leaves your device.
- **Always Free**: No signup, no limits, no premium tier. Every tool is completely free forever.
- **166+ Currencies**: Currency converter supports 166+ world currencies with live exchange rates.
- **Live Exchange Rates**: Currency rates updated daily from exchangerate-api.com.
- **Fast & Reliable**: Powered by Cloudflare's global CDN. Tools load instantly from anywhere in the world.
- **No Dependencies**: Works entirely client-side with pure JavaScript. No external API calls (except IP lookup and currency rates).
- **NIST Compliant**: Password Generator follows NIST SP 800-63B guidelines for digital identity.
- **Readability Analysis**: Word Counter provides Flesch Reading Ease and Grade Level scores.
- **Security Headers**: X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options enabled.

## Use Cases

- **Math & Finance**: Use Calculator for scientific functions, unit conversions, loan calculations, and BMI calculations. Currency Converter for live exchange rates.
- **Writing & Content**: Use Word Counter to analyze readability and keyword density for SEO optimization.
- **Security**: Generate strong passwords with entropy analysis, verify password strength.
- **Network**: Check your public IP address, test internet speed, verify network settings.
- **API Development**: Format JSON responses, test regex patterns, encode URLs.
- **Database Work**: Format SQL queries, generate UUIDs for records.
- **Web Development**: Beautify HTML, generate QR codes for apps.
- **DevOps**: Create cron expressions, convert timestamps, manage time zones.
- **International Business**: Convert currencies and manage time zones for global teams.

## Technical Details

- All tools use semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy
- Schema.org structured data for search engines (WebApplication with datePublished/dateModified)
- FAQ sections with common questions and answers
- Mobile-responsive design
- Accessible navigation
- Web Crypto API for cryptographically secure random number generation
- IndexNow integration for instant Bing indexing

## SEO Information

Each tool page includes:
- Unique title and meta description (under 60 chars title, 155 chars description)
- Canonical URL
- Schema.org JSON-LD (WebApplication)
- FAQ sections with common questions and answers
- External authoritative references (NIST, OWASP, W3C, IETF)
